text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — P1: redis-prod-eu-1 accept_queue length > 1000, blocked_clients high, 99th latency spike. Alert: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 created and assigned to @dylan.oncall (primary). Escalation policy: oncall -> secondary (15m) -> eng-sre lead.

dylan.oncall: acked. I'm taking the page. Looking at Redis dashboards (accept queue, blocked_clients, ops/sec). Quick Q: any deploys or config changes affecting cache warmers in last hour?

elaine: not infra. We kicked off recommendations-backfill at ~09:12 that ramps writes to cache. Job: https://ci.example/jobs/7789

dylan.oncall: pulling redis INFO snapshot:

```
# Clients
connected_clients:987
blocked_clients:432
maxclients:1000

# Stats
instantaneous_ops_per_sec:11234
used_memory:12GB
```

blocked_clients=432 and accept_queue>1000 — kernel accept backlog. That's causing high latencies and upstream timeouts. Plan: temporarily raise maxclients, throttle the backfill, and enable API backpressure for non-critical endpoints.

leo-db: FYI seeing rising pgbouncer wait for product-read queries that miss cache. If Redis isn't stable, Postgres might feel cascade. Recommend enabling read-only fallback for rec endpoints.

dylan.oncall: executing mitigations:
- redis CONFIG SET maxclients 2000 (temp)
- scale down recommendation-backfill to 10% concurrency
- flip rec_api_throttle feature flag to on for prod

Commands:
```
redis-cli -h redis-prod-eu-1 CONFIG SET maxclients 2000
kubectl scale --replicas=2 job/recommendation-backfill -n prod
ldctl set-feature rec_api_throttle --env prod --on=true
```

matt_sre: note — raising maxclients increases sockets but not threads; watch memory. If used_memory climbs, be ready to evict or restart instance on shard. Consider short-term egress limit at LB to shed background traffic.

dylan.oncall: CONFIG SET accepted. `redis-cli CONFIG GET maxclients` => 2000. blocked_clients dropping 432 -> 68 after scaling back job. ops/sec decreasing. `ss -ltp` shows accept queue draining.

support-bot: Customers: ~12 tickets flagged for rec endpoint 503/504 in last 25m. Not a global outage. Logged to CSM.

elaine: I'll monitor dashboards and run a canary to validate no memory pressure. If stable in 10m, let backfill continue at reduced rate.

incident-bot: INC12345 acknowledged by dylan.oncall at 2026-03-15T09:26:12Z. Auto-escalation scheduled in 15m if unresolved.

leo-db: bumped pgbouncer app_pool pool_size 50->70 to reduce queueing: `pmm-cli apply --profile prod pgbouncer/app_pool --pool-size 70` — 1min rollout.

dylan.oncall: metrics check: blocked_clients ~3, accept_queue < 20, 99th latency back to baseline. memory stable: used_memory 12.3GB/32GB.

elaine: running extended regression on canary path. Support, please prep customer DM referencing INC12345 and mitigation steps.

support-bot: Draft DM:
"We experienced transient increased latency and errors on the recommendations endpoint due to cache saturation. Our on-call team increased connection limits and throttled a background job to stabilize the system. Most customers unaffected; a small subset may have seen failed requests. Full post-incident summary will follow."

matt_sre: follow-ups for post-handoff:
- add auto-throttle/circuit for background backfills
- alert for blocked_clients >100 for >5m (currently only accept-queue alerted)
- runbook: prefer gradual warmers or producer-side rate limits

dylan.oncall: handing off to @elaine for monitoring and post-incident tasks. I'll annotate INC12345 explaining temporary maxclients bump and pgbouncer tweak. Reachable if it flares.

elaine: taking handoff. Will close PD incident once metrics stable and support sends customer note.

incident-bot: INC12345 — status: mitigated (accept_queue drained, blocked_clients ~3). Acknowledged and handed to elaine; escalation cancelled.

dylan.oncall: quick ✅ thanks team. I'll open a PR to update runbook in ~30m.

leo-db: thumbs up :thumbsup: Recommend short postmortem to decide on sharding cache-warmers vs producer rate limits.

support-bot: marking tickets with incident link and will send DM once elaine confirms.

elaine: final check: memory stable, pgbouncer normal, support DM queued. Closing PD in 10m unless regression. :white_check_mark:

matt_sre: opening tickets for alert tuning and controlled backfill deploy canary.

dylan.oncall: handoff complete.

(reacts: multiple :eyes:, :thumbsup: on dylan.oncall messages)
